context_features.industry_mom20: Same signal-date eligible industry mean momentum_20; fewer than 5 finite observations or Unknown industry falls back to universe mean
context_features.industry_rank20: Average-tie rank of momentum_20 within eligible industry: (rank-.5)/n-.5; fewer than 5 finite observations or Unknown falls back to universe rank
context_features.universe_mean_mom20: Equal weight mean of finite momentum_20 among signal-eligible stocks
context_features.universe_breadth20: Fraction of finite eligible momentum_20 strictly above zero
context_features.universe_dispersion20: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of eligible momentum_20

config.population: Signal-eligible population only, including stocks whose future label is missing. Finite observations only; no target information. Industry mean includes self. These universe proxies are not an external market index.
config.preprocessing: Ridge: original and added columns use training-only .005/.995 clipping, median fill and population scaling. LightGBM: original 21 use centered same-date cross-sectional ranks then existing training median/scaling; added 12 use raw training-only clipping/fill/scaling, preserving common market context and interactions. No label normalization.
config.selection: Parent two-window equal-weight mean Rank IC, ties choose first grid entry; choose independently within four designs. Persist every candidate; reuse existing fitted candidates for evaluation and portfolios, no refit.
config.portfolio_scope: 2020-2021 only, verified corporate action/settlement ledger; original top-decile and round1 constrained portfolios. 2019 prediction metrics only. No portfolio metric used for selection.

parent.boundary: Training label_end_date must not exceed train end; preprocessing fitted on training only. Equal weight per evaluation date, then equal weight per window.
parent.selection: Mean Rank IC across two windows; exact ties choose simpler/earlier fixed configuration. Ranking diagnostics do not create additional tuning objectives.
parent.unseen_evaluation: New period must be named and frozen before accessing its research data; 2022-2025 cannot be reused as unseen test. No new-period data read in round 1.
parent.optimizer: Maximize same-date percentile score by linear programming across all signal-eligible stocks. Full investment; no turnover penalty or covariance optimization in round 1. SIC two-digit industry; unknown is separate. Missing beta/vol imputed with contemporaneous universe median; abort if column entirely missing. Infeasible/failed solve aborts, never relaxes based on performance.

execution.timing: every fifth signal date, next-close execution
execution.exceptions: existing approved OTC quote proxy and CVR exclusion unchanged

evaluation.primary: Paired change in annualized mean daily net active return versus universe EW

parent.scope: Constraints apply to signal targets. Fees, unavailable securities, inherited positions and between-rebalance drift may change realized exposures; report execution deviations. Industry histories are effective-dated CRSP SIC, not guaranteed unrevised point-in-time releases. This is a risk-controlled observational experiment, not causal attribution.
